CBS fixtures trimmed from CBS News' public election archive API.
Not a documented API; the adapter is a scraper and disabled by default.

- races2-2024-tx.json: https://api-election.cbsnews.com/archive/api/public/races2/2024/G?filter.officeCode=S&filter.state=TX
  plus https://api-election.cbsnews.com/archive/api/public/races2/2024/G?filter.officeCode=H&filter.state=TX
  Trimmed to the Texas Senate race and TX-38, with winning candidate only.
  The top-level JSON is a list of race objects.
